artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- validate initial value
    if input.initial_value == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local delta: number = input.current_value - input.initial_value
    local raw_pct: number = (delta / input.initial_value) * 100

    -- proper rounding to 2 decimal places for positive and negative numbers
    local scaled: number = raw_pct * 100
    local rounded_scaled: number
    if scaled >= 0 then
        rounded_scaled = math.floor(scaled + 0.5)
    else
        rounded_scaled = math.ceil(scaled - 0.5)
    end
    local percentage_change: number = rounded_scaled / 100

    local direction: string
    if percentage_change > 0 then
        direction = "up"
    elseif percentage_change < 0 then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = percentage_change, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percentage change between two numbers (2 decimal places) and direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need the percent change and whether a value moved up, down, or stayed flat.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}

    local list_res = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if not list_res.ok then
        return { error = list_res.error, message = list_res.message }
    end

    local customers: { CustomerRef } = list_res.customers or {}
    local sends_done: number = 0
    for _, cust in customers do
        if sends_done >= 10 then
            break
        end
        if cust.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            local text = "Hi " .. cust.name .. ", we miss you!"
            local send_res = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
            if not send_res.ok then
                table.insert(failed, cust.id)
            else
                table.insert(notified, cust.id)
                sends_done += 1
            end
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: List a segment's customers and message those inactive for a threshold (up to 10 sends).
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you want to notify customers in a segment who haven't been seen for >= inactive_days
